issues.reason: Core patterns' "assert only what the text states": with (Past sk_see_1) beside the bare class and role atoms the parse asserts a seeing that occurred, whereas the text states only that fog was the sole thing available to be seen.

Only is an existing licensed opaque focus head, not a coined one, and (Only fog sk_see_1) is true of the sentence's exclusivity claim ("nothing but X" = "only X"), so this is graceful improvisation in gap territory rather than a defect.

gaps_confirmed: exceptive "but" after a negative quantifier ("nothing but X") has no stated encoding
negative existential "there was nothing" — the no/none route needs a kind to carry strength 0.0 and bare "nothing" supplies none
potential passive infinitive "to be V-ed" (= visible/available) has no stated carrier
new_gaps: past tense on an availability reading has no carrier: keeping (Past e) re-asserts the occurrence the modality denies, so the "was" is dropped in the repair
repair_summary: Replaced (Past sk_see_1) with the licensed capability status atom (Can sk_see_1), so the availability modality is recorded and no occurred seeing is asserted — the shape of "Sam is fit enough to run", where a merely possible event's class and role atoms stand at top level under (Can e).
notes: Roles are otherwise right: agentless passive omits the Experiencer and the perceived entity is Stimulus, with bare mass "fog" correctly a constant. Can is the nearest licensed carrier for "to be seen"; the construction itself remains a registered gap.
